findings.message_pattern: L5 promotable: 'lem-l5-valid' has a fresh VALID L5 verdict

aism_behavior: class-driven (no AISM counterpart -- the L5 verdict store is M3.7's own deliverable, orphaned in v1, first wired to a gate here).
notes: M3.8 deliverable 3: a 'status: stated' shard with a FRESH (hash-bound to current bytes) VALID L5 verdict on file -> WARN 'L5 promotable', never an ERROR (this is a status-computation NUDGE, not a validity violation -- see src/gates/linker-l5.ts's header). l5ContentHash was computed as the raw sha256 of this exact shard file's bytes (sha256sum), matching the l5ContentHash domain (docs/worker-contract.md section (f): raw shard-file bytes, no normalization) that src/gates/snapshot.ts's fileSha256 also reports.
